files.transformation: Namespace imports only for v1 constants/functions and fields. Rename the v2 CASES global to SURFACE_CASES in its declaration and controls body to avoid collision; all values/assertions/signatures unchanged.

No build/native/run/cleanup function is imported.

Actual capture, native launch and current boundary admission are not imported.

Keep original protocol_rows/wire and first six pure ProtocolControls methods exactly; replace only module imports. Remaining original environment/lifecycle methods belong to supervision/admission and are not claimed here.
Import namespace only; all four original tests unchanged. Add the current 2026 Pear contributors copyright header; retain the original MIT notice and unchanged test bodies.
Exact six original PresentationTests; only method-local import namespaces change.

Original three frame tests, namespace/pixel-mock path changes and explicit synthetic producer Path(__file__) corresponding to the new required producer argument. Add the current 2026 Pear contributors copyright header; retain the original MIT notice and unchanged test bodies.
Namespace import only; all nine original finite ordering tests preserved. Add the current 2026 Pear contributors copyright header; retain the original MIT notice and unchanged test bodies.

Preserve original setUp/helpers and twelve result-contract tests. Rebind manifest file read to manifest(). Exclude only the two generator-only mixed tests; add separate duplicate JSON refusal in the new adapter tests. No source generator is imported.
files.cpu_provider_adaptation: Explicit required provider parameter is threaded through original result assertions; only the duplicate effective_case implementation is replaced by the canonical FEX import. Existing assertions and outcomes are unchanged.

boundaries.expected: Expected exit 42 after native file/time/event operations and exactly-once callback/context assertions; validate the same PE on native Windows.
Expected exit 42; coordinator and one guest worker retain distinct TLS and return through normal thread cleanup.
Expected exit 42; one handled UD2 updates RIP/RAX, one data guard is cleared, nested native call returns correctly.
Expected exit 42; coordinator and worker change 41 to 42, failed removal preserves executable metadata.
Expected exit 42; running worker R12 is observed as 17, changed to 42 and resumed with normal join.
Exact stack alignment, nonvolatile GPRs and XMM6-XMM15 survive a native call and guest callback; capture input/output state and compare the same PE on native Windows.
A guest frame with a declared handler receives an intentional exception, preserves nonvolatile state and executes the expected handler/finally path; compare native Windows before Pear.
Two workers use aligned locked RMW operations; final count equals the declared combined iteration count, with no lost update; record each actual thread policy.

Two workers perform plain assembly stores data then flag and loads flag then data; flag=1 with old data is forbidden under the declared x86 contract. Epoch handshakes remain outside the measured sequence.
Two workers store own location then load the other; (0,0) is allowed without a fence. The locked/fenced variant forbids (0,0); missing worker/iteration records cannot pass.

unsupported.addresses: Required fixed guest mappings must succeed. Round/coalesce Windows reservations without silently relocating absolute operands. Scratch is guest data, not native executable memory.
unsupported.config: Match/Ignore differential-state masks, MM/x87 and non-production Env overrides are not supported by the first selected harness contract; census names exclusions.
unsupported.features: AVX lane case requires actual guest exposure plus native AVX/OSXSAVE availability; no 128-bit-only pass. Other unselected ISA features remain unqualified, not proven absent from the game.
unsupported.fp: Finite normal-value SSE conversion/arithmetic cases; arbitrary NaN payloads, x87 extended precision and all rounding/DAZ/FTZ modes remain unqualified.
unsupported.i386: Execution unperformed; module construction in #5 is not helper qualification. Required Steam helpers remain #11 dependency.
unsupported.ordering: Unperformed until actual per-thread-policy and multiworker cases execute. A single-thread xadd/cmpxchg result does not prove ordering.

absolute-displacement.reason: The Pear image arena occupies 0x7fff0000, so the original Linux fixed data page conflicts with the PE loader before instruction execution. Keep all upstream register expectations; relocate only data accesses and retain the original upper disp32 LEA boundary in R8.
